approved.en: Ukrainian drones have intensified attacks on St Petersburg, striking oil facilities, a refinery, a bridge and data centers, while a separate strike hit a Russian oil terminal. President Trump has waived several Russia sanctions, prompting Zelenskyy to accuse him of rewarding Putin, and Lithuania has foiled an arson attack on Starlink equipment suspected to involve Russia. Zelenskyy says Russia seeks a total blackout of Ukraine's energy grid as winter approaches, and Ukraine continues to rely heavily on Starlink communications. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

The EU has condemned the settler attacks on diplomats and demanded accountability. The Board of Peace is urging Israel to admit Gaza technocrats and an international force. The conflict caused 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Iran and Iraq foreign ministers discussed regional security, including the Hormuz Strait, Palestine and Yemen conflicts, and the Kurdistan Regional Government warned that a coalition exit could enable an ISIS resurgence. The conflict recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Communal clashes continue in Jonglei, where an attack on Miny Island left dozens missing, and a cattle keeper was injured by a wild animal in Aweil North, while a truck driver was killed on the Juba-Nimule road. The UN special envoy is urging President Kiir and other leaders to choose consensus over confrontation, and the African Union has voiced deep concerns about the renewed clashes. Uganda defended its military deployment in South Sudan, and the US ambassador met with Kiir to discuss communal conflicts. A pastor received death threats in a refugee camp and a Juba Dal activist was hacked to death in Cumilla. Two battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

FN-spesialutsendingen oppfordrer president Kiir og andre ledere til å velge konsensus fremfor konfrontasjon, og Den afrikanske union har uttrykt dyp bekymring over de fornyede sammenstøtene. Boko Haram is rebuilding its ranks, training about 8,000 children and preparing a new generation of fighters, while Cameroon urges drones and joint border patrols to secure the Nigeria-Cameroon frontier.
